title: Fix Tree Indentation Lines Above Items
description: Sometimes vertical indentation lines are not updated until the parent. On procedural catalogue transforms rotate tree item, tree items above don't show vertical indentation - vertical line is missing.
summary: Fixed missing vertical indentation guides for tree items above a nested row: row hover/selection backgrounds now apply only on tree-row-content (gutter stays transparent), tree-guide z-index raised, and branch layout changes re-apply the hover path when sections expand or children update.
